findings.title: Keep the two-臼 analysis distinct and faithful to the scan
findings.details: Repeated independent reviews require the proposal involving two 臼 forms with 冖 to remain distinct from the rare element read jù. The scan reports “两臼（犹升）从冖” and assigns 臼 a sound role; it does not establish that these are two standard 臼 characters or explicitly describe them as 臼-shaped. The latest draft includes the distinction but needs this precision preserved in future repairs.
